suite: voice call swallowed by self-barge-in (user: 现在又没有成功调用了)
symptom: Press Option, speak, release -> pet says 「好，等这个任务完成。」 and nothing reaches DSH.

logEvidence_1353_attempt.05:45:35.171: nisse.barge_in_pending (same turn marked as barge-in of the previous response slot)
logEvidence_1353_attempt.05:45:36.681: nisse.barge_in_queued turn=voice-...-2 interruptedTurnId=voice-...-2 (SELF) -> spoke 「好，等这个任务完成。」
logEvidence_1353_attempt.05:45:38.151: response done; no bridge turn for the user's request

rootCause: The qwen realtime runtime flagged the new utterance as a barge-in of the response slot it was itself replacing. Our barge-in queueing logic trusted that flag and queued the user's own request (instead of delegating it), so DSH never saw it.
fix: bridge-turn: if pending barge-in turnId == current turnId -> clear flag, ignore (self-barge-in).
bridge-turn: if pending barge-in exists but no bridge turn is running (currentTurn === null) -> stale flag, clear and proceed.
queueing is now only used when a real DSH turn is running (protects tool calls from being aborted).
verification: m4/bot-evidence/VOICE-QUEUE-E2E.json (clean conversation): two utterances back-to-back -> two completed turns, 0 aborted bridge events, queue notices/flushes logged; gateway restarted with route C + guards.
also: Option quick-tap now latches listening (tap to start, tap again to send) so short presses no longer produce a silent '好，先不听'; spoken-aware bubbly replies.
